events.input: $ cd /tmp; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/?v=$(date +%s)" -o t144live.html; wc -c < t144live.html; grep -c "Two-Month Platform Pass" t144live.html; grep -c "1 month, worth" t144live.html; git -C /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign show HEAD:workshop-plan/index.html | cmp - t144live.html && echo IDENTICAL; gh api repos/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live/commits/HEAD --jq '.sha[0:7]+" "+.commit.message' | head -1

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; gh api "repos/adisuja/tantra-workshop-live/commits?path=index.html&per_page=1" --jq '.[0].sha[0:7]'; node app/scripts/probe-review-hub.mjs 2>&1 | tail -3; python3 - <<'E'
